title: A tab does not indent the continuation line of a plain scalar
notes: The value is in a block mapping at indentation 0, so its continuation lines need a flow line prefix of 1 space (production 69: exactly n spaces, then optional white space), and a line that starts with a tab has none. Tabs are separation, never indentation. A tab may start a comment line, so the tab itself is acceptable and `b` is the first character that cannot belong. Compare yaml-test-suite DK95/01, the same rule for a double-quoted scalar.

provenance.reference: A reader that counted a tab as indentation and read the two lines as the scalar `a b`.
